Gehlot calls for Congress unity ahead of Rajasthan panchayat polls

Rajasthan Chief Minister Ashok Gehlot has urged Congress leaders to unite for the upcoming panchayat polls in the state. He also cautioned party leaders about the potential misuse of police and administration by the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) during the elections.
